companyFieldUpdates.description: Unison Energy, LLC develops, finances, builds, owns, operates and maintains behind-the-meter microgrids and distributed-energy systems for commercial and industrial customers across North America. Its primary model uses long-term energy-service agreements and project SPVs, while the company also supports customer-owned EPC, operations-and-maintenance and hybrid structures; not every system is therefore owned by Unison. The platform serves healthcare, data-center, industrial, hospitality, logistics and other resilience-sensitive facilities using combined heat and power, controls, solar, batteries and thermal systems. At Tiger's June 2024 entry, public materials described approximately 30 operating or signed-ESA projects and about 26 MW installed; a current aggregate scale is not publicly disclosed. Tiger Infrastructure Partners Fund III acquired control through Fund III AIV U LP on June 17, 2024 from American Infrastructure Funds/AIM Universal and Hunt Companies. Exact percentages and consideration were not disclosed, and no later sale or signed ownership transfer was identified through August 19, 2026.
